display.purpose: Landing hero only — one per page (the One Exhibit Rule).

headline.purpose: Ledger section headings; italic 700 variant for pull-quotes.

label.purpose: Evidentiary micro-labels: exhibit numbers, hashes, field names, KPI captions.

shadows.name: desk-object
shadows.purpose: Hard offset shadow for paper terminals and interactive objects on the page.

shadows.name: desk-object-sm
shadows.purpose: Compact desk widgets (signature pad, small panels).

shadows.name: exhibit-photo
shadows.purpose: The one soft shadow — photographic evidence frames only.

shadows.name: sealed-node
shadows.purpose: Gold verification glow, exclusively for chain nodes at the moment they seal.

motion.name: ease-evidence
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for reveals: redaction lifts, evidence flips (0.8–0.9s).

motion.name: spring-magnetic
motion.purpose: framer-motion spring for magnetic buttons (legacy hero).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled, square, mono-labeled — the examiner's decisive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #14120b); color: var(--paper, #f3eee2); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14120b); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2b2718; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foil-gold, #a8842c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent with a hard ink border; secondary actions on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14120b); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14120b); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(20,18,11,0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foil-gold, #a8842c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rubber Stamp
components.description: A rotated, double-ruled certification mark — VERIFIED, FLAGGED, SEALED. Declarations only, never neutral tags.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--stamp-red, #c2331f); border: 3px double var(--stamp-red, #c2331f); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; transform: rotate(-4deg); }

components.name: Ledger Label
components.description: The evidentiary micro-label that captions every exhibit, hash, and field.
components.css: .ds-ledger-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4434); }

components.name: Paper Terminal
components.description: Machine output rendered on paper — live agent traces, SQL, hashes. Hard desk-object shadow.
components.html:
$ hypothesis 3/5 — structuring
SELECT count(*) FROM tx WHERE amt BETWEEN 9000 AND 9999;
→ 47 rows · p=0.0021 · CONFIRMED
sha256: 8f1c…e2a9 ✓ chained
components.css: .ds-paper-terminal { background: #fffdf6; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14120b); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(20,18,11,0.22); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.9; padding: 22px 26px; color: var(--ink, #14120b); }

components.name: Exhibit Frame
components.description: Photographic-evidence mat: the one soft shadow in the system.
components.css: .ds-exhibit { background: #fffdf6; padding: 10px 10px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,18,11,0.25); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,11,0.18), 0 14px 34px -12px rgba(20,18,11,0.38); margin: 0; max-width: 280px; } .ds-exhibit-img { height: 140px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #ece5d3 0 31px, rgba(20,18,11,0.14) 31px 32px); border: 1px solid rgba(20,18,11,0.18); } .ds-exhibit-cap { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a4434); padding-top: 10px; }

components.name: Sealing Chain Node
components.description: The signature component: a spine ring that seals gold when its ledger entry verifies.
components.css: .ds-chain { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: center; padding: 8px; } .ds-chain-node { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2.5px solid rgba(20,18,11,0.14); background: var(--paper, #f3eee2); transition: border-color 0.6s, box-shadow 0.6s; } .ds-chain-node.ds-sealed { border-color: var(--foil-gold, #a8842c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(168,132,44,0.18), 0 0 18px rgba(168,132,44,0.45); }

narrative.overview: Verita's interface is a registrar's book: paper that remembers, ink that cannot be quietly changed, stamps that certify, a chain of seals running down the spine. The visual language is evidentiary, not decorative — surfaces are physical objects on an examiner's desk. The system explicitly rejects its own legacy, the generic dark-AI-SaaS template (aurora glows, glassmorphism, gradient text), which is documented as migrating, not canonical.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink, and stamps as the primary material vocabulary
Hard offset shadows — objects sit on the desk, nothing floats in glow
Fraunces 900 serif headlines against JetBrains Mono evidentiary micro-labels
Certainty rendered as ritual: stamps slam, seals set, chains verify, hashes tick
WCAG AAA contrast: text is ink, never gray

rules.name: The Iron-Gall Rule
rules.body: Text on paper is ink — #14120b or #4a4434, nothing lighter. Gray body text is forbidden; AAA (7:1) is the floor, not the target.

rules.name: The Ceremony Rule
rules.body: Vermilion, green, and gold are stamps, not paint. If an accent covers more than a stamp's worth of area, it has lost its authority.

rules.name: The Mono Witness Rule
rules.body: Every figure that testifies — hash, transaction ID, score, timestamp, SQL — is set in JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The One Exhibit Rule
rules.body: One Display-size element per page. Headlines argue; they don't shout over each other.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset and opaque-edged (6px 6px 0), never ambient blur. If a shadow is blurry, it's either a photograph or a mistake.

dos: Do keep text at WCAG AAA (7:1) — Iron-Gall Ink or Faded Ink on paper; fix Dimmed Starlight (#8c97b5 → ≈#98a3c0) wherever legacy dark surfaces are touched.
Do use hard offset shadows (6px 6px 0) and 2px ink borders for every new elevated surface, in both worlds.
Do set every hash, ID, score, and timestamp in JetBrains Mono (the Mono Witness Rule).
Do render certainty as ritual: stamp slams, chain seals, signature strokes — each with a prefers-reduced-motion crossfade fallback, always.
Do keep ceremonial accents (Vermilion, Registrar Green, Gold Foil) at stamp scale (the Ceremony Rule).
donts: Don't extend the generic dark-AI-SaaS template — no new aurora/mesh gradient glows, no new glassmorphism panels, no gradient text (.gradient-text is legacy; never apply it to new elements).
Don't use blur-glow elevation on new work; if a shadow is blurry and it isn't a photograph, it's wrong (the Hard Shadow Rule).
Don't let the ledger become a costume: no fake leather, no parchment JPEG textures, no skeuomorphic chrome. The forensic feel is carried by type, rule lines, stamps, and shadow — all CSS.
Don't put gray text on paper. #8c97b5-style muted grays are a dark-world token; on cream, the only secondary text color is Faded Ink (#4a4434).
Don't round corners on ledger components. Square is certain; 14–28px radii are legacy glass.
Don't animate without a reduced-motion alternative — the custom cursor, magnetic buttons, and stamp choreography must all degrade to instant/crossfade.
